description: Theme backdrop score recipes. polarity +1 = up is good for the theme, -1 = up is bad, 0 = unused. Scores recompute when contributing packs update (e.g. end of lab_economics job).

signal.note: Map YoY % into [-1, +1] by clipping at ±yoy_clip_pct, then score = 50 + 50 * weighted mean of (polarity * signal).

Ticker-local (CSTL). Same — overlay later, not theme backdrop.
